scientific_role: Complete the already-defined v094s source-free temporal opportunity census by making the implementation conform to the v094s contract: legacy infinity-sky tangent-plane geometry is diagnostic only and an undefined legacy diagnostic must not veto a temporally eligible cross-site opportunity.

retain temporal opportunities when the legacy diagnostic is UNRESOLVED and emit null legacy geometry metrics
re-read staged output and require exact 13177 pair keys plus exact timing/association signatures
publish final outputs only after all replay guards pass
